verdict.rationale: Marketing pages for Mesh agentic workflows say the agents auto-remediate only level 1 alerts and automatically escalate high-risk or complex cases to human expert review. That is a first-party remediation boundary plus human escalation. However, there is no documentation that users can set or tune that boundary by policy, and the Starter Plan says agent configurations are standardized and cannot be customized. Missing for 10: documented policy controls for what the agent may auto-remediate, configurable escalation thresholds for ambiguous findings, in-depth technical docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
